original_content.raw_text_en: Information security policy and topic-specific policies should be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

original_content.raw_text_en: Information relating to information security threats should be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

extracted_elements.description_draft: Information relating to information security threats should be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

original_content.raw_text_en: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel should be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics and proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

original_content.raw_text_en: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties should receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

original_content.raw_text_en: Security perimeters should be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.

original_content.raw_text_en: Premises should be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.

original_content.raw_text_en: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks should be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

original_content.raw_text_en: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media should be deleted when no longer required.
